title: Ines and the Spire
premise: Ulyana Crane, the last swordspeaker whose oaths can bind steel to truth, has spent a decade hiding her gift since the crown outlawed it. When she is caught sheltering Prince Aldric — the true king, bound by a usurper's spell and hidden in the body of a common soldier — she must smuggle him through Thornfell to the Spire where the binding was forged. Hunted by the crown's witch-finders and betrayed by the comrade she loves, she learns the usurper wears Aldric's own father's face. At the Spire, Ulyana speaks one final oath that shatters the binding at the cost of her gift, freeing the king but leaving her voiceless to magic forever; Aldric takes his throne, and chooses her over duty.
about_author: Isandro Lockridge is the pen name of a former mountain guide who traded trail maps for story maps after a winter spent snowed in with nothing but a notebook. Their fiction blends hard-won landscapes with quiet, stubborn heroes who carry more than they say.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Toll
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Guiding a caravan through Thornfell, Ulyana senses a bound soul among the refugees: Prince Aldric, disguised and spell-silenced. When crown witch-finders raid the pass, she uses her forbidden gift to cut them free of a truth-snare, exposing herself. Emotional beat: reluctant compassion overriding a decade of careful hiding.

chapters.title: What Wears the Crown
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Fleeing together, Aldric reveals fragments of his captivity while Ulyana teaches him to trust again. In the free city of Vess, they discover the usurper's proclamation bears King Edran's face — the father Aldric mourns still lives, hollowed and worn like armor by the thing on the throne. Emotional beat: grief curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: The Traitor's Road
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Her oldest friend and fellow smuggler, Bren, sells their route to the witch-finders for amnesty. Ambushed at the Spire's threshold, Ulyana must duel Bren while Aldric faces the binding's keeper — the usurper's sorcerer wearing his mother's shape. Emotional beat: loyalty shattered, love confessed in the space between blade-strokes.

chapters.title: One Oath Remaining
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs converge at the Spire's heart, where King Edran — half-aware inside his stolen body — begs release. Ulyana speaks her final oath, unbinding father and son alike as her gift burns out of her. The usurper unravels; Aldric claims the throne and publicly names Ulyana his equal, not his sword. Emotional beat: sacrifice answered by chosen love.
